messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a fun, recognizable drawing. Let me build it: bicycle with two wheels, frame, handlebars, a pelican body sitting on the seat, big beak, wing, legs pedaling. I'll keep it clean with layered shapes and reasonable coordinates in a viewBox like 0 0 400 300.

Let me sketch coordinates:
- Wheels: rear wheel center (110, 210) r=45, front wheel center (310, 210) r=45.
- Frame: from rear hub to seat tube, down to bottom bracket, to front fork. Bottom bracket at (210, 210). Seat top ~ (170, 130). Handlebars ~ (290, 120).
- Frame lines: (110,210)-(170,130) seat tube chain stay; (110,210)-(210,210) chain stay; (210,210)-(170,130) seat tube; (210,210)-(290,120) down tube; (170,130)-(290,120) top tube; (290,120)-(310,210) fork.
- Pelican body: ellipse centered around (190, 130) sitting on seat. Body ellipse rx 55 ry 40 at (190,125). Neck and head to the right: head circle at (255,95). Long beak pointing right with pouch.
- Wing: shape on body.
- Legs from body down to pedal crank at (210,210).
- Handlebars at (290,120): horizontal bar.

Add spokes, ground line. Colors: pelican white/gray body, orange beak/pouch, black outlines.

Let me write the SVG carefully.

Beak: from head (255,95) extend right ~70 px long. Upper mandible line and pouch below.

I'll produce final SVG with comments.
answer:
Here's an SVG of a pelican hard at work on its bicycle:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <!-- Ground -->
  <line x1="20" y1="258" x2="380" y2="258" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="110" cy="210" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="110" cy="210" r="5" fill="#222"/>
  <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="110" y1="168" x2="110" y2="252"/>
    <line x1="68" y1="210" x2="152" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="78" y1="178" x2="142" y2="242"/>
    <line x1="142" y1="178" x2="78" y2="242"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="310" cy="210" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="310" cy="210" r="5" fill="#222"/>
  <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="310" y1="168" x2="310" y2="252"/>
    <line x1="268" y1="210" x2="352" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="278" y1="178" x2="342" y2="242"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="178" x2="278" y2="242"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bicycle frame -->
  <g stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="110" y1="210" x2="180" y2="130"/>  <!-- seat stay -->
    <line x1="110" y1="210" x2="210" y2="210"/>  <!-- chain stay -->
    <line x1="210" y1="210" x2="180" y2="130"/>  <!-- seat tube -->
    <line x1="210" y1="210" x2="295" y2="120"/>  <!-- down tube -->
    <line x1="180" y1="130" x2="295" y2="120"/>  <!-- top tube -->
    <line x1="295" y1="120" x2="310" y2="210"/>  <!-- fork -->
  </g>

  <!-- Seat -->
  <path d="M 160 128 Q 180 118 198 128 L 195 134 L 165 134 Z" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <g stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="295" y1="120" x2="292" y2="98"/>
    <path d="M 292 98 Q 305 88 320 95"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Crank and pedals -->
  <circle cx="210" cy="210" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="210" x2="228" y2="196" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="224" y="192" width="14" height="6" fill="#222"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="210" x2="192" y2="224" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="182" y="222" width="14" height="6" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- Pelican legs (one on each pedal) -->
  <g stroke="#e67e22" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M 195 165 Q 210 180 228 195"/>
    <path d="M 185 168 Q 185 200 194 222"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pelican body -->
  <ellipse cx="190" cy="130" rx="60" ry="42" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#444" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <path d="M 132 118 L 100 100 L 112 122 L 96 128 L 128 138 Z" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Wing -->
  <path d="M 165 118 Q 205 108 230 140 Q 200 160 170 150 Q 158 132 165 118 Z"
        fill="#dcdcdc" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <path d="M 175 135 Q 195 128 215 142" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 172 144 Q 192 138 208 150" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Wing reaching to handlebar -->
  <path d="M 225 125 Q 260 115 290 100" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M 235 108 Q 250 80 258 62" fill="none" stroke="#f5f5f5" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 235 108 Q 250 80 258 62" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5" opacity="0"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="262" cy="55" r="18" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#444" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="268" cy="50" r="3" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="269" cy="49" r="1" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Beak: upper mandible -->
  <path d="M 278 52 Q 320 48 348 58 Q 320 62 282 62 Z" fill="#f39c12" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Pouch -->
  <path d="M 280 62 Q 300 88 330 66 Q 342 60 348 58 Q 330 70 305 70 Q 290 68 280 62 Z"
        fill="#f7b731" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Head tuft -->
  <path d="M 255 38 Q 258 30 264 34" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
```

Some details included:
- **Two spoked wheels** with a red diamond frame, seat, and handlebars
- **A crank with pedals**, with the pelican's orange legs pedaling (one foot on each pedal)
- **Classic pelican features**: a big throat pouch (slightly bulged — he may have had lunch), long beak, tail feathers, and a wing stretched out gripping the handlebar

You can save this as `pelican-bike.svg` and open it in any browser. Want a different style (cartoony, minimalist line art, or animated pedaling legs)?
